text:
Jasmine Liu: Quick q on the PLG→sales signals rollout. We need hard suppression rules for enterprise / CS-managed accounts so SDRs don’t auto-enroll sequences. What’s the plan for when an “expansion” signal fires on an account that already has a CSM + active renewal motion?

Rachel Kim: +1. Also need guidance: Dedicated→Private upsell… should route to CSM first (since we own relationship) vs AE (since it’s pipeline)? We’ve had a few messy handoffs already.

Dev Patel: And can we suppress if there’s an open support escalation? Last thing we need is a “hey want to chat about Dedicated” email while we’re firefighting 5xxs.

Isabelle Laurent: Yep, we can bake this into HubSpot workflow logic but we need the exact conditions. Right now v1 draft is: if signal_score >= X then create task + enroll SDR sequence unless “active opp” or “opt out”. Sounds like CS needs more.

David Kim: From a systems view, I can add a boolean property like `plg_signal_suppressed` + `plg_suppression_reason` (single select) and have workflows short-circuit. But we need source-of-truth rules + who sets those flags.

Grace O'Connor: +please keep it deterministic. SDR team doesn’t want to guess if it’s “CS-owned” vs “AE-owned” when the task comes in.

Jasmine Liu: Proposed suppression/route matrix (happy to adjust):
1) If Company has CSM Owner (not blank) OR Account Tier = Enterprise OR “CS Managed = true” → do NOT enroll SDR sequence. Create CS task + notify #customer-success.
2) If there is an open Deal in stage {Discovery, Evaluation, Procurement, Security Review, Negotiation} → suppress all outbound sequences + just log timeline event (for visibility) and create task for current Deal owner.
3) If Support Escalation flag = true OR open Sev2+ incident linked → suppress outreach entirely (timeline-only) until cleared.
4) If explicit opt-out / do-not-contact → suppress everything except internal timeline.

Rachel Kim: This looks right. For #1, I’d tweak: if it’s CS-managed but expansion opportunity exists, we still want AE looped. Maybe: create task for CSM as primary + @mention AE owner in task notes.

Markus Klein: From SE side, I’d prefer: Dedicated→Private and Security Intent should go to AE+SE (pipeline motion) but CSM should be notified. A lot of the “Private” work is solutioning + procurement.

Stephanie Nguyen: Agree. Ownership-wise: net-new expansion = AE. But CS-managed account shouldn’t get SDR spam.

Chris Osei: Can we split “suppression” from “routing”? Like: suppression prevents SDR sequences, but routing still assigns an owner + task based on account state.

Isabelle Laurent: Yes. Something like:
- `plg_outreach_allowed` (T/F)
- `plg_task_owner_role` (CSM / AE / Deal Owner)
- `plg_notify_channels` (#sales, #customer-success)
We can implement in workflow branches.

Dev Patel: For support escalation suppression: we already have `support_escalation_status` in HubSpot for enterprise accounts, but self-serve might not. Could we treat “open support ticket with priority P0/P1” as escalation too?

David Kim: We have ticket sync for Zendesk/Jira for enterprise + some paid. For self-serve, it’s spotty. But we can add a property `support_priority_max_last_14d` from telemetry/support pipeline later. For v1, we can use the existing `support_escalation_status` + `open_tickets_count` where available.

Jasmine Liu: Ok. For the “when expansion routes to CSM vs AE” question, I’d suggest:
- If Account Tier = Enterprise OR CSM Owner exists: CSM is primary for relationship/outreach; AE is looped for anything that creates pipeline.
- If signal category is “Security intent” or “Data residency” or “Private docs engagement”: primary owner = AE (or Deal Owner if exists), notify CSM.
- If signal category is “Usage growth / 429s / latency pain” on an enterprise account: primary = CSM (since it may be success/health), notify AE only if spend threshold is met (e.g., likely upsell).

Rachel Kim: + add “Renewal window” logic. If renewal in next 90 days, CSM primary always. Any new deal should be tied to renewal strategy.

Isabelle Laurent: We can do that if we have `renewal_date` populated. Do we?

Jasmine Liu: For most enterprise yes. Not for self-serve.

Chris Osei: Let’s keep v1 simple and safe:
- Suppress SDR sequence if (CSM Owner exists) OR (Account Tier = Enterprise) OR (Active Deal exists) OR (Do Not Contact) OR (Support Escalation).
- Routing: if Active Deal exists → task to Deal Owner. Else if CSM Owner exists / Enterprise → task to CSM Owner. Else → task to AE/SDR based on geo/segment.
- Notifications: #customer-success for enterprise/CSM-owned signals; #sales for everything else above a high-intent score.

Grace O'Connor: Works. Just make sure timeline event still gets written so SDRs/AE can see what happened, even if suppressed.

Markus Klein: +1. Also add “SE assist” flag for categories {Security intent, Residency, Private}. Those should auto-create an SE assist task or at least tag SE team.

David Kim: For now I can add `plg_next_best_action` text field and populate with “Loop SE” / “Offer Dedicated PoC” etc. Workflow can include it in task description.

Stephanie Nguyen: Please define the exact HubSpot properties names + allowed values so we don’t end up with 5 variants.

Chris Osei: Action items:
- Chris: update PRD with suppression + routing rules as above (v1) + add v1.1 notes for richer support/ticket signals.
- Jasmine/Rachel: provide list/definition of “CS Managed” criteria (CSM Owner vs Tier) + confirm renewal window usage.
- David/Isabelle: propose exact HubSpot property schema (`plg_suppression_reason`, `plg_task_owner_role`, `plg_outreach_allowed`, `plg_next_best_action`) and share back here.
- Grace/Stephanie: confirm SDR/AE expectations: suppressed = no sequence enrollment, but AE can still do manual outreach.

Jasmine Liu: :thumbsup: I’ll send criteria + a quick list of current enterprise/self-serve-to-enterprise “watch accounts” for pilot suppression.

David Kim: Got it. I’ll draft properties today and post screenshot of workflow branches once configured.

Dev Patel: Thanks. Can we also add a note in playbook: if suppressed due to support escalation, do not outreach until CSM clears it.

Chris Osei: Yes, adding that to enablement + runbook.
